text:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PD: P0 | inference-prod-eu | spike in 5xx and increased latencies (customer-facing), link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456 :rotating_light:
PagerBot: auto-ack window elapsed, no auto-ack. routing to on-call[:eyes:]
Alex G.: I'm the first responder, taking ownership. grabbing logs now.
Priya R.: oncall noted, joining. I'll start correlating tails from model-serving and mesh gateway.
Tom H.: I can flip traffic to the standby dedicated pool if we confirm backend errors. preparing a quick route plan.
Sara L.: I'll loop in CS for high-value customers seeing errors. drafting a customer note.
Alex G.: quick check: `kubectl -n inference-prod logs deploy/gateway -c proxy --tail=200 | grep 5.. | head` shows a lot of `502` and `OOM` hints.
Priya R.: seeing KV cache evictions in redis metrics around the same time, eviction spikes at ~12:02 UTC.
Tom H.: running a controlled traffic shift -> `curl -X POST https://ops-api/redwood/reroute -d '{"route":"dedicated-eu-standby","weight":0.3}'`
PagerBot: route change recorded; traffic partial shift in progress.
Alex G.: after shifting ~30% traffic, 5xx rate dropped 40% for those requests. Looks like a localized backend degradation.
Priya R.: digging into autoscaler logs: `autoscaler-controller` restarted multiple pods due to memory pressure. suspect config change from earlier rollout.
Tom H.: rolling back autoscaler image to previous stable tag: `kubectl set image deployment/autoscaler controller=autosc:v1.2.1`
Sara L.: CS notified customers A & B; they acknowledged receipt and will monitor.
PagerBot: PD update posted: responders on call: Alex G., Priya R., Tom H.
Alex G.: pinpoint: recent autoscaler tweak lowered memory limit for sidecar which caused OOM and cascade. patching now to restore limits.
Priya R.: applying hotfix to `gateway-sidecar` limits -> `kubectl apply -f hotfix/gateway-sidecar-limits.yaml`
Tom H.: autoscaler rollback completed, sidecar limits restored.
Alex G.: 5xx rates back to baseline across region. Latency normalized. Confirming with synthetic checks.
PagerBot: monitoring window started (30m). Will keep PD open until stable window passes.
Sara L.: sending short status to affected customers: "We observed a transient error spike affecting inference requests caused by an autoscaler config change; traffic has been rerouted and a hotfix applied; monitoring in progress."
Alex G.: mark for postmortem: root cause = autoscaler config change during rollout reduced memory limits for sidecar; cascading OOMs -> 502/5xx. Follow-ups: stricter rollout guard, increase canary wait, alert on eviction spikes.
Priya R.: I'll own the postmortem draft. tagging stakeholders and scheduling a 30-min post-incident sync.
PagerBot: Update on PD: responders acknowledged, incident moved to "Mitigated". Will mark resolved after stable window (ETA 30m). :white_check_mark:
Tom H.: closing notes: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/kv-eviction and I've added the rollback command snippet there.
Alex G.: thanks team. I'll post timeline + logs to the incident channel once collected.
Sara L.: thanks — CS will follow up with customers after the 30m window.
PagerBot: Incident resolved -> final status: Mitigated -> Will create incident ticket and assign to Priya R. for postmortem. :tada:
